title: The Hot Hut
lines: Deb and Kip set up a hut of mats.
It is hot in the sun.
"It is hot in the hut," said Kip.
Deb hops up. She gets a big tan mat.
She sets it on top of the hut.
Deb and Kip sit. It is not hot!
"Deb did it," said Kip. He gets figs.
Deb and Kip sit and hum in the hut.

questions.ask: What did Deb and Kip make?
questions.listenFor: A hut out of mats. The first line says it. If your child is stuck, point at that line and let them read it again.

questions.ask: Why did Deb put a big mat on top of the hut?
questions.listenFor: Because it was hot inside. The mat kept the sun off. Lines two, three and five carry it. Cause and effect is the thinking here.

questions.ask: Where would you build a hut? Tell me why there.
questions.listenFor: Any place is fine. You are listening for a reason of their own, and it is a lovely chance to go and build one.
